get.description: Returns a paginated list of Work Orders. Supports filtering and sorting via query parameters.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Define how many items will be received in the payload per request.(default 20 items, max 1000 items)

parameters.name: statusCompleted
parameters.description: Filter by the completed state of the work order.

parameters.name: updatedAtFrom
parameters.description: Filter by updatedAt date FROM the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

parameters.name: updatedAtUntil
parameters.description: Filter by a updatedAt date UNTIL the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

parameters.name: createdAtFrom
parameters.description: Filter by createdAt date FROM the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

parameters.name: createdAtUntil
parameters.description: Filter by a createdAt date UNTIL the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

parameters.name: dueDateFrom
parameters.description: Filter by dueDate FROM the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

parameters.name: dueDateUntil
parameters.description: Filter by a dueDate UNTIL the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.
